items.title: A w-local morphism of w-local affine schemes which identifies local rings is ind-Zariski
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a ring map which identifies local rings and whose source and target spectra are w-local with a w-local morphism between them is ind-Zariski (statement lines 1184-1193). The proof (proof lines 1195-1221) constructs an ind-Zariski cover of X with the same components as Y, produces a morphism from Y to that cover by faithfulness for local isomorphisms, and concludes by the isomorphism criterion for w-local morphisms bijective on closed points. H2: a three-step comparison with three inputs, written out in full.
